# FlytheBG

FlytheBG is a free, browser-first image toolkit focused on background removal and passport photo creation.

## Primary tools
- Background Remover: /remove-background
- Passport Photo Maker: /features/passport-photo
- Features: /features
- FAQ: /faq
- Guides: /guides
- Browser Privacy Guide: /guides/browser-privacy

## What FlytheBG does
- Removes image backgrounds locally in the browser.
- Exports transparent PNG cutouts.
- Creates print-ready passport photo sheets with physical sizing and DPI controls.
- Supports manual passport-photo positioning and framing.
- Uses WebGPU when available with CPU/WASM fallback for compatibility.

## Privacy and processing
The current image workflow is designed so the working photo is processed in browser memory rather than requiring a FlytheBG image-processing upload backend. Browser users may still download application code, AI model/runtime assets, fonts, video, and optional advertising assets.

## AI model disclosure
FlytheBG integrates IMG.LY's browser background-removal package and IS-Net model variants. Third-party model and runtime assets are not claimed as FlytheBG-owned models.

## Important limitations
Background removal is an AI-assisted estimate. Fine hair, fur, glass, smoke, reflections, motion blur, compression, and low contrast can produce imperfect segmentation.
